verdict.rationale: TaxJar's own API reference documents a dedicated sandbox endpoint (api.sandbox.taxjar.com/v2/) separate from production, which supports the core of testing against a sandbox. The evidence is a single endpoint listing, so isolation from production data is only implied, and how to use the sandbox is not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is isolated from production, sandbox key provisioning and access details, sandbox feature parity or limitations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
